intent: Rising spray carries the player through tall shafts; control the sideways exit onto dry ledges. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The first falling river
sections.lesson: Jump into the spray · steer onto the dry ledge. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The first falling river
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The river’s stone arches
sections.lesson: Cross the dry arch crowns between the falls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The river’s stone arches
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The tall waterfall
sections.lesson: Let the spray do the climbing. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The tall waterfall
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: Behind the falling water
sections.lesson: Descend through the dry chambers behind the falls. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
Behind the falling water
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The upper river outlet
sections.lesson: Exit each column before the next stone wall. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The upper river outlet
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The river turns back
sections.lesson: Leave these falls to the left before crossing to the next outlet. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The river turns back
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

sections.name: The last rising cascade
sections.lesson: Ride the final cascade towards the spring gate. Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.

signs.text:
The last rising cascade
Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent.
